udid.description: Target specific device by UDID. Leave empty for auto-detection.

network.description: Connect to network device via Wi-Fi.

notify_wait.description: Wait for app installed/uninstalled notification before reporting success.

command.description: The command to execute: list, install, uninstall, or upgrade.

path.description: Path to the .ipa, .ipcc, or .app directory for install/upgrade commands.

sinf.description: Path to an external SINF file for install/upgrade commands.

metadata.description: Path to an external iTunesMetadata file for install/upgrade commands.

bundle_identifier.description: Bundle ID of the app to uninstall or query.

attributes.description: Attributes to return when listing apps. See --attribute in man page.
